plan.change: Synchronize five existing canonical development documents with tested, active-only bounded work-local staging fast path and preserve original secure Plan requirements for all other paths.
expectedChanges: Document two narrow Plan-free staging routes: completely new isolated work, or bounded modifications/additions in exactly one lifecycle-active preexisting work.

Specify active-only requirements: <=4 ordinary files, no deleted/renamed/symlink/exec mode, protected packaging/metadata, <=120 modified lines and 16 KB patch, max file sizes and exact Git base lifecycle.
Explain exact prior version restoration is only within active work local classifier and does NOT allow Plan-free shared/town/Engine rollback.
Frozen, candidate, released, town/shared, lifecycle data, two work, production retain Plan Lock and existing gates.
Cite real no-Plan canaries #250 active PASS, #251 frozen blocked, #252 released blocked, #253 shared blocked, #254 new PASS, #255 candidate blocked, all closed unmerged.
ownerDecisions: Owner requested easing isolated new and active existing local edits while protecting existing shared and published content; no production approval.
hqDecisions: This PR updates docs only to match actual CI, not a new gateway exemption.
Owner aesthetic signoff, human/device verification, production publication and shared UI design remain separate decisions.

plan.problem: Installed security gates now allow bounded active local edits without Plan Lock, but operations docs still state all existing edits are excluded.
plan.currentContract: Two pinned base-owned protected workflows recognize one new work or one existing lifecycle-active bounded work while rejecting shared and public work changes.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Stale instructions cause needless Plan preparation and mislead when existing active work tweaks can be safely routed.
plan.design: Precisely edit five existing runbooks without touching any workflow, tools, registry, games or production.
plan.migration: Document the tested behavior only after positive and negative real PR canaries pass.
